CustomField.description: The single status column the FSD specifies: None, CRITICAL, Verified, Completed. SHIPPED AS ONE PICKLIST BY EXPLICIT BUSINESS DECISION, against the design recommendation to split severity from state. KNOWN AND ACCEPTED CONSEQUENCE: completing a critical item overwrites CRITICAL, so this field can only answer which critical items are still open and can never answer how many a deal had. Reports needing severity must use Is_Critical__c; the open-wire-risk count must use Is_Wire_Verification__c. Done means Completed OR Verified - a rollup or report written against Completed alone silently undercounts every verified item.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Status of this item. CRITICAL marks an open high-risk item; it is replaced by Completed or Verified once the item is worked.
CustomField.label: Flag
